title: knowledge.ingest_requested (v1)
description: An upstream agent (ProblemModelingAgent, DeepResearchAgent, NoveltyAuditAgent, or ResearchOrchestrator) asks KnowledgeIndexAgent to ingest one or more IndexEntryInput items into the knowledge index. Only path_or_ref and summary (plus optional tags) are supplied by the caller; type/source/produced_by_state are filled in by KnowledgeIndexAgent's core at ingest time.

path_or_ref.description: Path or opaque ref identifying the artifact being indexed.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the artifact.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags. Defaults to empty if omitted.
